# Shared deterministic presentation. No program state is stored here.
abt_std_istable(x) = x isa NamedTuple && keys(x) == (:__abt_table__, :rows, :columns, :types, :source) &&
                     x.__abt_table__ === true
function abt_std_table_error(operation, table, err)
 message = sprint(showerror, err)
 startswith(message, "ABT ") && throw(err)
 error("ABT $operation: file '$(table.source)': cause: " * message)
end
function abt_std_render(x, nested=false)
 if x isa NamedTuple && keys(x) == (:__abt_fasta__, :path, :alphabet, :ambiguity, :case_policy) && x.__abt_fasta__ === true
  return "fasta(arquivo=" * repr(x.path) * ", alfabeto=" * repr(x.alphabet) * ")"
 elseif abt_std_istable(x)
  try
   return "tabela(" * join((abt_std_render(row, true) for row in x.rows), ", ") * ")"
  catch err
   abt_std_table_error("mostrar", x, err)
  end
 elseif x isa NamedTuple
  content = join((string(k) * " = " * abt_std_render(v, true) for (k,v) in pairs(x)), ", ")
  return "(" * content * (length(x) == 1 ? "," : "") * ")"
 elseif x isa AbstractVector
  return "[" * join((abt_std_render(v, true) for v in x), ", ") * "]"
 elseif x isa String
  return nested ? repr(x) : x
 elseif x === missing
  return "ausente"
 end
 return Base.invokelatest(string, x)
end

function pseudo_sum(xs)
    total = 0
    for x in xs
        total += x
    end
    return total
end
function pseudo_average(xs)
    total = 0
    count = 0
    for x in xs
        total += x
        count += 1
    end
    count > 0 || error("Cannot average an empty selection")
    return total / count
end
abt_list(xs...) = isempty(xs) ? Any[] : (mapreduce(typeof, typejoin, xs)[xs...])
function abt_filter(xs, predicate)
    xs isa Vector || error("Semantic error: collection operation requires a Vector")
    return filter(xs) do value
        selected = predicate(value)
        selected isa Bool || error("Semantic error: filter predicate must be Bool")
        selected
    end
end
function abt_map(xs, transform)
    xs isa Vector || error("Semantic error: collection operation requires a Vector")
    isempty(xs) && return Any[]
    return map(transform, xs)
end
function abt_limit(xs, count)
    xs isa Vector || error("Semantic error: collection operation requires a Vector")
    typeof(count) === Int64 && count >= 0 || error("Semantic error: limit requires a nonnegative Int64")
    return xs[1:min(count, length(xs))]
end
function abt_unary(op, value)
    (typeof(value) === Int64 || typeof(value) === Float64) || error("Semantic error: unary $op requires a number")
    return op == "+" ? +value : -value
end
abt_invoke(fn, args...) = Base.invokelatest(fn, args...)
function abt_external_field(obj, field)
    startswith(field, "_") && error("ABT interop: atributo privado não permitido: $field")
    return obj isa AbstractDict ? obj[field] : getproperty(obj, Symbol(field))
end
function __abt_program_main__()
    Base.invokelatest(println, abt_std_render((((1 + (2 * 3)) - 4) - 5)))
    Base.invokelatest(println, abt_std_render(((10 / 2) / 5)))
    Base.invokelatest(println, abt_std_render(((1 + 2) * 3)))
    Base.invokelatest(println, abt_std_render(((1 + 2) >= 3)))
end
__abt_program_main__()
end
